people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.
translations.bsb: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them proceeds the human descent of Christ, who is God over all, forever worthy of praise! Amen.
translations.kjv: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
translations.asv: whose are the fathers, and of whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
